methodology: official docs re-check + CSP header extraction + live API probe (mainnet + testnet) + OpenAPI spec analysis + HTML source inspection
key_corrections: First-pass said 'No embedded wallet evidence found' — this is WRONG. The CSP headers from app.ethereal.trade clearly contain auth.privy.io in frame-src, and HTML source contains 'funkit' (Fun.xyz embedded wallet/onboarding SDK). Ethereal IS integrating embedded wallet infrastructure, even if it's not yet prominently surfaced in docs.
CSP also reveals MoonPay integration (static.moonpay.com, api.moonpay.com) — fiat on-ramp is present or in development.

Testnet funding has become MORE restrictive, not less. First-pass said 'users submit an access request through the app, and the testnet distribution system funds accounts in under 24 hours.' Current docs now say there is no public faucet — developers must 'Reach out to a team member Discord in #developer-support' for testnet funds.
WebSocket has been upgraded: native WebSocket v2 at wss://ws2.ethereal.trade/v1/stream is now primary, old Socket.io endpoint is deprecated.
API surface is larger than first-pass captured: 49 endpoints total, including referral system, points, whitelist, rate-limit config, maintenance status, dry-run orders.
Linked signer quota system now confirmed: configurable max per time period, currently 5 per 7 days across all subaccounts, queryable via /linked-signer/quota.
first_pass_still_valid: Wallet-first onboarding model — no email/social login path documented in API or developer guides.
All trading through subaccounts, first deposit creates subaccount.
Default subaccount name 'primary' (bytes32 encoded) is still recommended.
EIP-712 per-action signing model (no JWT/API key alternative).
Linked signers cannot withdraw, expire after 90 days inactivity.
Fresh wallet returns empty subaccounts and 404 Signer not found.
8 distinct signed action types confirmed via /v1/rpc/config.

mainnet_products.note: Up from first-pass. Public, no auth.

testnet_products.note: Testnet has more products than mainnet.

mainnet_subaccounts.note: Still no subaccounts for test wallet. Consistent with first-pass.

csp_analysis.privy: auth.privy.io in frame-src — embedded wallet / auth integration present
csp_analysis.funxyz: *.fun.xyz and wss://*.fun.xyz in connect-src; 'funkit' found in HTML — Fun.xyz wallet SDK integrated
csp_analysis.moonpay: static.moonpay.com and api.moonpay.com in connect-src — fiat on-ramp
csp_analysis.walletconnect: Multiple *.reown.com, *.walletconnect.org, *.walletconnect.com entries across script-src, connect-src, frame-src
csp_analysis.relay: api.relay.link in connect-src — Relay cross-chain bridging
csp_analysis.zerion: dna.zerion.io in connect-src — Zerion wallet integration
csp_analysis.lighter_cross_ref: mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai in connect-src — cross-reference to ZK Lighter

testnet_access.current_state: No public faucet. Must request testnet funds via Discord #developer-support.
testnet_access.change_from_first_pass: Previously described as 'submit access request through app, funded in under 24 hours'. Now explicitly Discord-only.

key_points: Deposit to new subaccount auto-creates it
Only USDe supported, wraps to WUSDe via depositUsd() convenience method
Pending state during offchain indexer verification
Linked signer rate limit: 5 per 7 days across all subaccounts
All resting orders from revoked signer must be canceled first
7 channel types: L2Book, Ticker, TradeFill, PositionUpdate, OrderUpdate, OrderFill, SubaccountLiquidation, TokenTransfer

updated_assessment.web2_friendliness: Medium — higher than first-pass described. CSP reveals Privy (auth.privy.io) and Fun.xyz (funkit) integrations, plus MoonPay fiat on-ramp. But none of these are documented in developer guides or prominently surfaced — they appear to be frontend-only integrations, possibly for upcoming features or A/B testing via Statsig.
updated_assessment.api_order_usability_from_cold_wallet: Still low. Fresh wallet has empty subaccounts and 404 signer. Must deposit first to create subaccount, then use EIP-712 signing per action. No API key alternative.
key_friction_points: No API key auth — every action requires EIP-712 signature
First deposit required to create subaccount
Testnet funding now requires Discord request (no public faucet)
Linked signer rate limited to 5 per 7 days
Only USDe (wrapped to WUSDe) supported for deposits
updated_assessment.what_changed_vs_first_pass: The biggest correction is the embedded wallet infrastructure — Privy and Fun.xyz ARE present in the live app's CSP and HTML, contradicting the first-pass 'no embedded wallet evidence found.' However, this appears to be frontend integration only (not reflected in API docs). Testnet access has become more restrictive (Discord-only vs former app-based request). API surface is richer than first-pass captured (49 endpoints). WebSocket has been upgraded to native v2.
